about_the_game:
What if you fell asleep during a test… and never woke up?

Dave, a second-grade student, dozed off during a math quiz. When he opens his eyes, he finds himself in a familiar yet twisted place—a school where nothing is quite right. The walls whisper, doors lead nowhere, and from the shadows emerges something that looks like his teacher. But this is no longer a man.

Welcome to a dreamworld that lives and shifts on its own terms—reacting to your actions and your fears. Every step you take, every decision, every attempt to hide from the teacher’s gaze matters. Time works differently here: the longer you stay, the deeper the nightmare pulls you in. The teacher learns. He watches. He adapts.

Dreamscape Pursuit is a first-person psychological horror game that blends stealth, evasion, and exploration with an emotional narrative about childhood fear, guilt, and the feeling of being trapped. At the heart of the experience lies our custom-built AI system, inspired by the cognitive processes of the human brain. Your enemy doesn’t just hunt you—he remembers your behavior, analyzes your playstyle, and adjusts his actions emotionally. He’s not just playing against you. He’s trying to understand you before he stops you.

This isn’t just a dream. This isn’t just a horror game. It’s a battle with your own mind, in a world that knows your fears better than you do.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 3 1200 / Intel Core i3-8100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD R9 380 (min. 4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: AMD Ryzen 5 5600 / Intel Core i5-11400
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

short_description: Trapped in a dream at his school, a young boy must evade a relentless teacher and find a way out before time runs out and the line between reality and nightmare disappears.
supported_languages:
English*, Polish
*languages with full audio support
